decisions.summary: Synthetic organization IDs route to local stores; UUID IDs route to Supabase.
Local catalog mutations persist through browser localStorage with swallowed storage errors; this is not remote synchronization.
Remote Supabase operations do not fall back to local fixtures on failure.
Products has no offline mutation queue or replay.
Real remote mutations require online server acknowledgement until queue/version/access semantics are approved.
Offline remote reads from cached authorized snapshots are undefined.
Business state, connectivity, entity sync state and mutation state are separate dimensions.
Use idempotency and optimistic versions when approved; do not use last-write-wins.
Demo fixtures are not automatically uploaded or merged into remote organization data.
Shared Platform capabilities retain their own synchronization and persistence boundaries.
Adapter selection by organization ID shape must be replaced by explicit runtime configuration.
Category sync and categoryKey migration wait for approved category identity, scope and lifecycle.
